## sol ### (a) $$\begin {align*} \int_{1}^{\infty} e^{-x} \left \{ \int_{0}^{1} e^{-2y}\,\,dy\right \} dx &= (1-e^{-2}) [e^{-x}]_{1}^{\infty} \\ \\ &= e^{-1}(1-e^{-2})\end{align*}$$ ### (b) $$\begin{align*}\int_{0}^{\infty} 2e^{-2y} \left [ \int_{0}^{y} e^{-x}dx\right ]dy &= \int_{0}^{\infty}2e^{-2y}(1-e^{-y}) dy \\ \\ &= 1 \,+\, \frac {2}{3}(-1) = \frac {1}{3}\end{align*}$$ ### (c) $$f(x) = \int_{y \in (0,\infty)} f(x,y) dy$$ $$\therefore \,\, f(x) = e^{-x}$$ $$ P\{X ## sol $$f(x,y) = e^{-x-y}$$ $$Z = \frac{X}{Y}$$ $$X = ZU,\,\, Y = U$$ $$|J| = \begin {vmatrix} \frac{\partial x}{\partial z} & \frac{\partial x}{\partial u} \\ \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} & \frac{\partial y}{\partial u} \end{vmatrix} = \begin {vmatrix} U & Z \\ 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = U$$ $$\therefore f(z,u) = f(x,y) = ue^{-(z+1)u}$$ $$\begin {align*} f(z) &= \int_{0}^{\infty} f(z,u) \,\,du \\ \\ &= 0 + \frac{1}{z+1} \int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-(z+1)u}\, du = \frac{1}{(z+1)^2} \\ \\ &= \frac{1}{(\frac{x}{y}+1)^2} \end{align*}$$ --- # example on page 25 find the joint probablity mass function of $(X_1, X_2)$
## sol $X_{1} = \omega_{1} + \omega_{2} = s$ $X_{2} = |\omega_{1} - \omega_{2}| = d$ $\therefore P_{X_{1},X_{2}}(s,d) = P(X_{1} = s, X_{2} = d)$를 구하자. `1` 조건 정의 - $\omega_1 \geq \omega_2$라고 조건 가정. $$\omega_1 = \frac{s+d}{2},\quad \omega_2 = \frac{s-d}{2}$$ `2` 따라서 해가 존재하려면, 다음 조건을 만족해야함 - $s \pm d$가 짝수여야함. - $1 \leq \omega_1 \leq \omega_2 \leq 6$ - $d = 0 $: 기능한 개수 $N(s,0) = 1$ - $d > 0 $: 기능한 개수 $N(s,d) = 2$ `3` 따라서... 최종 joint probablity mass function of $(X_1, X_2)$ $$P_{X_1, X_2}(s,d) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{36}, \quad d = 0, s \in \{2,4,6,8,10,12\} \\ \frac{2}{36}= \frac{1}{18}, \quad d \in \{1,2,3,4,5\}\,\,\text{even},\,\,1 \leq \omega_1 \leq \omega_2 \leq 6\ \\ 0, \quad \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$ --- # example on page 26
## sol `1` $f_{y}(y)$ 구하기 $$\begin {align*} f_{y}(y) &= \int_{0}^{1} \frac {12}{5}x(2-x-y) \,dx \\ \\ &= \frac{12}{5} \left [ \int_{0}^{1} 2x - x^{2} -xy \,dx \right ] \\ \\ &= \frac{12}{5} \left (\frac{2}{3} - \frac{y}{2} \right) \\ \\ &= \frac {2}{5} (4-3y)\end{align*}$$ `2` $f_{X|Y}(x|y)$ $$\begin {align*}f_{X|Y}(x|y) &= \frac {f(x,y)}{f(y)} \\ \\ &= \frac{6x(2-x-y)}{4-3y}\end {align*}$$ $$\therefore \,\, f_{X|Y}(x|y) = \begin{cases} \frac{6x(2-x-y)}{4-3y}, \,\, 0y, \dots Y_{n}>y)$$ `step3` 독립성 사용 $$P(Y_{1}>y, \dots Y_{n}>y) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} P(Y_{i}>y) = \left ( P(Y_1 > y) \right )^{n}$$ `step4` $$ P(Y_1 > y) = 1- P(Y_{1} y) = e^{-y/2}$$ `step5` 최종 CDF $$F_{M}(y) = 1- (e^{-y/2})^{n} = 1- e^{-ny/2}$$ `step6` 최종 pdf: $y$에 대해서 미분 $$f_{M}(y) = \frac{n}{2} e^{-ny/2}$$ --- # Suppose3.... $Y_1\dots Y_n$ is a random sample from the population with distribution $N(\mu,\sigma^{2})$. Find followings. ## (1) The distribution of Y1 + 2Y2 + 3Y3 ### sol 세 확률변수는 독립이고, 독립인 확률변수의 분포는 선형결합을 따르므로 - 독립이므로 공분산은 `0` $$Y_{1} + 2Y_{2} + 3Y_{3} \sim N(6\mu, 14\sigma^2) $$ ## (2) The variance of S2 $$S^{2} = \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} \frac{(Y_{i}-\bar{Y})^2}{n-1}$$ ### sol `step1` $$W=\frac{(n-1)S^{2}}{ \sigma^2} \sim \chi^{2}_{n-1}$$ $$\therefore\,\, S^{2} = \frac{\sigma^2}{n-1}W$$ 결론 $$Var(S^{2}) = \left ( \frac{\sigma^2}{n-1}\right)^2 Var(W) = \frac {2\sigma^4}{n-1}$$ ## (3) The distribution of $Y_2 - \bar Y$ and its mean and variance ### sol. 각 확률변수는 독립이므로 선형결합인 $\bar Y$와 $Y_2$도 독립 $E(Y_2) = \mu, E(\bar Y) = \mu$ $Var(Y_2) = \sigma ^2, Var(\bar Y) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}$ $$Cov(Y_2, \bar Y) = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n}Cov(Y_2, Y_i) = \frac 1n Cov(Y_2,Y_2) = \frac 1n\sigma^2$$ $$Var(Y2-\bar Y) = Var(y_2) - Var(\bar Y) -2Cov(Y_2, \bar Y) = \frac{n-1}{n}\sigma^2$$ $$\therefore\,\, Y_2 - \bar y \sim N(0, \frac{n-1}{n}\sigma^2)$$ ## (4) Cov... $$Cov(\bar Y, Y_2-\bar Y)$$ ### sol. `step1` 공분산의 선형성 $$Cov(\bar Y, Y_2-\bar Y) = Cov(\bar Y, Y_2) - Cov(\bar Y, \bar Y) = Cov(\bar Y, Y_2) - Var(\bar Y)$$ `step2` $$Cov(\bar Y, Y_2) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}, \quad Var(\bar Y) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}$$ $$\therefore\,\, Cov(\bar Y, Y_2-\bar Y) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n} - \frac{\sigma^2}{n} = 0$$ ## (5) independent? Are $Y_1 - Y_2$ and $Y_1 + Y_2$ independent? ### sol. $$U = Y_1+ Y_2,\,\,V = Y_1-Y_2$$ `1` 정규분포를 따르는 두 확률변수의 선형변환은 다시 정규분포를 따르므로 위 $(U,V)$는 이변량 정규분포를 따른다. `2` 공분산 계산 $$Cov(U,V) = Cov(Y_1, Y_1) - Cov(Y_1,Y_2) + Cov(Y_2,Y_1) - Cov (Y_2,Y_2) = 0$$ `3` 결론 $(U,V)$가 이변량(jointly)정규분포를 따르고, $Cov(U,V)$가 0 이므로 $$U,V \text{는 서로 독립이다.}$$ ## (6) The distribution of $$\sum_{k=1}^{5} \frac{(Y_{2k-1}-Y_{2k})^2}{2\sigma^2}$$ ### sol `step1` $$D_{k} = Y_{2k-1} - Y_{2k} \sim N(0, 2\sigma^2)$$ `step2` $$Z_{k} = \frac{D_{k}}{\sqrt {2}\sigma} \sim N(0,1)$$ $$Z_{k}^2 \sim \chi_{1}^{2}$$ `step3` 서로 독립인 카이제곱분포를 따르는 확률변수들의 가법성 성질을 이용하면! $$\therefore \,\,T = \sum_{k=1}^{5} Z_{k}^2 = \sum_{k=1}^{5} \frac{(Y_{2k-1}-Y_{2k})^2}{2\sigma^2} \sim \chi^{2}_{5}$$
